title: Logovanje i analiza logova: CloudTrail, CloudWatch Logs, Security Lake
summary: Kako izabrati i konfigurisati izvore logova (CloudTrail, VPC i Transit Gateway flow logs, Route 53 Resolver, ELB, CloudFront, S3, WAF), centralizovati ih u Log Archive nalog i Security Lake (OCSF) i analizirati ih pomoću CloudWatch Logs Insights, Athena, OpenSearch, Lambda i Managed Grafana.
title_en: Logging and log analysis: CloudTrail, CloudWatch Logs, Security Lake
summary_en: How to choose and configure log sources (CloudTrail, VPC and Transit Gateway flow logs, Route 53 Resolver, ELB, CloudFront, S3, WAF), centralize them in a Log Archive account and Security Lake (OCSF), and analyze them with CloudWatch Logs Insights, Athena, OpenSearch, Lambda, and Managed Grafana.
